title: Playback Transcode Jellyfin-Class Hardening
problem: Nako has strong playback/transcode seams, but Jellyfin/Plex-class hardening needs an explicit Interface freeze, owned scopes, shared scopes, and validation gates before multiple Codex lanes can work safely.
gates: git diff --check -- docs/workstreams/playback-transcode-jellyfin-class-hardening docs/architecture/LANES.md docs/architecture/WORKSTREAM_LINKS.md docs/architecture/PLAYBACK.md docs/workstreams/README.md
cargo nextest run -p nako-transcode pipeline hardware probe --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-transcode ffmpeg hls --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-server hls playback --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the playback/transcode hardening workstream, recorded the seam map, owned scopes, shared scopes, stop conditions, architecture links, and docs/planning gates for parallel Codex work.

Recorded first-batch worker prompts, suggested worktree branches, shared stop conditions, and task-local worker note paths for Playback Capability, Transcode Pipeline Capability, and FFmpeg Adapter lanes.
Merged playback capability hardening for remux output constraints and transcode requirement reasons, with focused nako-playback test coverage.

continue_policy.notes: PTJCH-110 is merged. PTJCH-120 and PTJCH-130 remain ready in separate worktrees using WORKER_PROMPTS.md; do not start PTJCH-210 or PTJCH-220 until the first batch merges or is split.
